description: Permissions of the main UwUMail window on every platform: only listening to the engine's events. Everything else goes through the app's own commands, which check their input in Rust; the tray and notifications are Rust's alone, and only the title bar's window controls (desktop.json) and the macOS menu bar (macos.json) are the page's. Addon frames never get Tauri access. Links open through open_link, not through the opener plugin's page API.
